_note: Dated activity feed. Newest first. date=YYYY-MM-DD (or YYYY-MM / YYYY). href optional (a page on this site or an external link). Add a line when a preprint goes out, a talk is accepted, a product ships, a chapter lands. Then run: python3 scripts/gen-rss.py

updates.en: Omytea becomes the umbrella for my products and research: an agent-native product, still early, is now its main effort, and all prediction work — the world-model research included — is gathered on its predict-line, open to whichever methods fit.
updates.zh: Omytea 成为我的产品与研究的总体系：一个仍处早期的 agent-native 产品成为当前主要工作；所有与预测有关的工作（包括世界模型研究）归入 predict-line（P 线），方法按任务选择、不设限。

updates.en: The Well (PolymathicAI) — two fixes merged upstream: ε propagated through the VRMSE/VMSE metrics (#92) and long-horizon validation curves averaged across batches (#93); written with Claude Code assistance, disclosed in the pull request.
updates.zh: The Well(PolymathicAI)—— 两处修复被上游合并:VRMSE/VMSE 指标中的 ε 传递(#92),以及长时程验证曲线改为跨批次平均(#93);借助 Claude Code 完成,已在合并请求中披露。
